---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the service does not support today? Describe the
use case, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you would like to happen. If it touches the API, sketch the route, request,
and response shape; if it touches classification, note the labels or prompts
involved.

## Scope

This project is built from the documents in `docs/` (`PRD.md`, `architecture.md`,
`phases.md`). Please note whether the request fits the current scope, extends it,
or is a new direction, so it can be triaged against the roadmap.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you did not choose them.

## Additional context

Links, references, or examples from similar tools.
